pictures.name: JLT1-Six-Days
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. One vast, luminous panorama of the newly made world: sky above with a golden sun on one side and a pale moon and stars on the other, a deep blue sea full of leaping fish, birds wheeling overhead, green land with trees and flowers, deer, lions and sheep in the meadows. Tiny and far away in the middle, the first man and woman as two distant silhouettes in garden light, seen from behind, fully and modestly clothed in long simple robes, faces not visible. Glowing gold light, deep blue shadows, abundance.

pictures.name: JLT2-No-Sun
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. The early world bathed in a soft, mysterious, shadowless golden light that comes from everywhere at once. The sky is empty, with no sun, moon or stars. Mountains, still water and new green plants glow from within. No figures. Wonder and quiet.

pictures.name: JLT3-Edge-To-Edge
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. A high green hilltop in the early world. The first man and woman stand far away as two tiny silhouettes, seen from behind, fully and modestly clothed in long simple robes, faces not visible, looking out over a whole world stretched below them in perfect clarity: seas, forests, rivers and distant mountains to the very edge of the earth, all lit by a clear golden light with no sun in the sky. Awe and clarity.

pictures.name: JLT4-Hidden
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Twilight over the early world. The soft golden light draws together into a single small, glowing radiance, like a treasure, that sinks gently into a hidden cave in a rocky hillside, lighting the cave mouth from within. Outside, the world turns deep blue. No figures. Mystery, tenderness, hope kept safe.

pictures.name: JLT5-Today
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Today: a warm modern kitchen at night, painted in the same oil style. An older woman with silver hair in a deep red sweater and a young man in a grey t-shirt sit at a wooden table with books open and two cups of tea, laughing together. A soft golden glow seems to rest on them, a little brighter than the lamp. Deep blue window, warmth.
